sections.description:
Transform your WordPress website into a conversion-optimized platform with Relayout Designs – a powerful collection of professional Elementor widgets designed to enhance user experience, boost engagement, and add enterprise-grade functionality without expensive custom development.

Why Choose Relayout Designs?

Relayout Designs provides essential widgets that typically require multiple separate plugins or costly custom development. Built specifically for Elementor, each widget is production-ready, fully responsive, and designed with both functionality and aesthetics in mind.

Perfect for:

  • 🏢 Web Agencies & Freelancers – Deliver professional features to clients faster
  • 🛒 E-commerce Sites – Enhance product pages and improve conversions
  • 📝 Content Creators & Bloggers – Increase engagement and readability
  • 💼 Business Websites – Add professional functionality instantly
  • 🚀 Marketing Teams – Create high-converting landing pages

FREE Widgets (7 Included)

1. Timeline Widget
Create beautiful visual timelines for company history, project milestones, or process steps.

  • Unlimited timeline items
  • Custom icons support
  • Completed/Pending status indicators
  • Fully responsive design
  • Perfect for About pages, project showcases, roadmaps

2. FAQ Accordion Widget
Organize your Q&A content efficiently with SEO-friendly collapsible sections.

  • Schema.org structured data for better SEO
  • Single or multiple accordion modes
  • Custom icons (Plus/Minus, Chevron, Arrow)
  • Expand/Collapse all functionality
  • Animation speed control
  • Reduce support tickets and improve self-service

3. Copy to Clipboard Widget
Enable one-click copying of text, code snippets, or coupon codes.

  • Instant copy functionality
  • Separate display and copy text
  • Success message tooltip
  • Icon customization
  • Inline or stacked layouts
  • Perfect for documentation, tutorials, promo codes

4. Disable Right Click Widget
Protect your images and content from easy copying.

  • Disable right-click context menu
  • Block text selection
  • Prevent keyboard shortcuts (F12, Ctrl+C, etc.)
  • DevTools detection with page blur
  • Customizable warning messages
  • Ideal for photographers, artists, premium content

5. Reading Progress Bar Widget
Show visitors how far they’ve scrolled through your content.

  • Visual scroll indicator
  • Top or bottom positioning
  • Percentage display option
  • Multiple animation styles (smooth, bounce, elastic)
  • Gradient color support
  • Increases time-on-page and reduces bounce rates

6. Current Year Widget
Automatically display the current year – perfect for copyright footers.

  • Dynamically updates every year
  • Prefix/suffix text support
  • Full typography controls
  • Alignment options
  • Set it once, forget about manual updates

Premium Widgets (10 Available)

The following widgets are available as a separate premium plugin at relayout.in. They are not included in this free plugin:

7. Feature Comparison Table ⭐
Create stunning side-by-side product or pricing comparisons.

  • Up to 5 products/plans comparison
  • Unlimited features to compare
  • 16 gradient color controls
  • Responsive mobile stacking
  • Perfect for SaaS pricing, product differentiation
  • Increases conversions by up to 40%

8. Checklist Manager
Add interactive task lists and checklists to any page.

  • Up to 10 checklist items
  • Persistent checked state
  • Checkbox size control
  • Custom checkmark styling
  • Great for tutorials, onboarding flows

9. Business Hours Widget
Display your operating hours with real-time Open/Closed status.

  • 7-day weekly schedule
  • Timezone support
  • Auto-highlight current day
  • Special hours & holidays
  • Perfect for local businesses, restaurants

10. Weather Widget
Show location-based weather information on your site.

  • No API key required – 100+ pre-configured cities
  • Real-time weather data
  • Temperature, humidity, wind speed
  • Multiple layout options
  • Ideal for travel sites, event planners

11. Instagram Feed Widget
Display your Instagram content directly on your website.

  • Native Instagram embeds
  • Multiple layouts (Carousel, Grid, Masonry, Pinterest)
  • Unlimited posts
  • Fully responsive
  • Build social proof, drive followers

12. Age Calculator Widget
Interactive date-based age calculations.

  • Multiple display formats
  • Auto-calculate option
  • Next birthday countdown
  • Birth day of week display
  • Full styling controls
  • Perfect for insurance sites, eligibility checks

13. Cookie Consent Widget
GDPR/CCPA compliance made simple.

  • Multiple layouts (Bar, Modal, Floating)
  • Cookie categories
  • Accept/Reject/Preferences buttons
  • Complete style customization
  • Legal compliance without expensive plugins

14. Business Chat Widget
Add direct messaging to your site.

  • Multi-platform support (WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram)
  • Floating chat button
  • Position control
  • Custom welcome messages
  • Increase customer inquiries instantly

15. Countdown Timer
Create urgency for sales, launches, and events.

  • Event countdown
  • Multiple date/time formats
  • Expiry actions
  • Custom labels
  • Perfect for limited-time offers, product launches

16. Delivery Date/Time Widget
Calculate and display estimated delivery dates.

  • Dynamic date calculation
  • Add days/hours/minutes
  • Customizable text templates
  • Real-time display
  • Reduces “when will I get it?” inquiries

Key Features

✅ Seamless Elementor Integration – All widgets appear in your Elementor widget panel
✅ Fully Responsive – Perfect on desktop, tablet, and mobile
✅ Lightweight & Fast – Optimized code that won’t slow down your site
✅ Regular Updates – Continuous improvements and new features
✅ Professional Design – Beautiful default styles, fully customizable
✅ No Coding Required – Drag, drop, and customize visually
✅ RTL Support – Works with right-to-left languages
✅ Translation Ready – Full internationalization support
✅ Browser Compatible – Works on all modern browsers

Privacy & Security

Relayout Designs respects your privacy:

  • ✅ No data collection from your visitors
  • ✅ GDPR compliant
  • ✅ No external API calls
  • ✅ All data stays on your server
  • ✅ Secure coding practices

Documentation & Support

Free Support:

  • WordPress.org Support Forum
  • Documentation: https://relayout.in/docs
  • Community Forum: https://relayout.in/community

Visit our website: https://relayout.in

Getting Started

  1. Install – Upload and activate the plugin
  2. Check Requirements – Ensure Elementor is installed
  3. Start Building – Find widgets under “Relayout Designs” category
  4. Customize – Use Elementor’s visual editor to style
  5. Publish – Go live with professional features

Additional Info

Support: For support questions, bug reports, or feature requests, please use the WordPress.org support forum.

Rate Us: If you love Relayout Designs, please leave a 5-star review. It helps us grow and improve!

  • Website: https://relayout.in
  • Documentation: https://relayout.in/docs

sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or greater
  • PHP version 7.4 or greater
  • Elementor 3.0.0 or greater (Free version compatible)

Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress Dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Relayout Designs”
  4. Click “Install Now” on the Relayout Designs plugin
  5. Click “Activate” after installation

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to WordPress Dashboard > Plugins > Add New
  3. Click “Upload Plugin” at the top
  4. Choose the downloaded zip file
  5. Click “Install Now”
  6. Activate the plugin after installation

After Activation

  1. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated
  2. Edit any page with Elementor
  3. Search for “Relayout” in the widget search bar
  4. Drag and drop widgets onto your page
  5. Customize using Elementor’s panel
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No! Relayout Designs works with the free version of Elementor. Elementor Pro is not required.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. Relayout Designs is built with performance in mind. The plugin only loads assets when widgets are actually used on a page.

Can I use these widgets with other page builders?

Currently, Relayout Designs is built specifically for Elementor. Support for other page builders may be added in future versions.

How do I get premium widgets?

The premium widgets are available as a separate plugin at relayout.in. They are not included in this free plugin.

Are the widgets translation ready?

Yes! All widgets are fully translatable and support RTL languages.

How do I report bugs or request features?

Use the WordPress.org support forum for this plugin.
